messages.subject: Middle East Executive Search | Mining, Energy, ESG & Government Relations
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Onen,

An earlier NGS Global outreach route rejected my message. I am therefore contacting you as an EMEA Managing Partner with experience across energy and senior leadership search.

I serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership exposure across government and regulatory relations, ESG, social responsibility, external affairs, executive advisory and strategic stakeholder engagement. My background spans mining, energy transition and major-project coordination.

Saudi Arabia is my first geographic priority, followed by the UAE, while I remain open to broader EMEA mandates. I am internationally mobile.

Executive profile: https://ragunauthramsaroop.com
LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/ragunauth-ramsaroop

I would value a confidential discussion or referral to the NGS Global partner best aligned with mining, energy and Middle East mandates.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
